EngLawName: Fee-charging Standards for National Taiwan Museum of Fine Arts Library Card Applications
name: 國立臺灣美術館藝術圖書中心閱覽證收費標準
histories: Promulgated on December 16, 2005 (The Council of Cultural Affairs, Executive Yuan Wen-Jian-Tzu No. 0941129172)

articles.content: The Standards are decreed in accordance with the Charges and Fees Act stated in Article 10,Paragraph 1.
An application fee of NT$50 would be charged by National Taiwan Museum of Fine Arts Art Library.
The Standards are executed since the date of promulgation.
